sources.title: Immigration Act, Cap. 6.02
sources.publisher: Law Commission of Saint Christopher and Nevis
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Law Commission publication provides the Immigration Act. Section 4 grants citizens entry at any time and Protocol Member State citizens an indefinite-entry permit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A citizen of Saint Christopher and Nevis has the right to enter Saint Christopher and Nevis at any time.

sources.title: OECS Protocol Member States
sources.publisher: Organisation of Eastern Caribbean States Commission
sources.officialityEvidence: The OECS Commission's current release identifies the seven Protocol Member States, six of which are catalog passport issuers including Saint Kitts and Nevis.
sources.supportingExcerpt: seven OECS Protocol Member States: Antigua and Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, Montserrat, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.

sources.title: Electronic Border Management System: eTA
sources.publisher: Ministry of National Security, Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis
sources.officialityEvidence: The live portal identifies itself as the official portal for the online Immigration and Customs ED Form and eTA, operated by the Ministry of National Security.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All visitors including infants and children who intend to travel to the Federation must have an approved Electronic Travel Authorisation.

sources.title: Government eTA launch release
sources.publisher: Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis
sources.officialityEvidence: The official 2025 government release says citizens of Saint Kitts and Nevis and OECS members do not need to apply for an eTA, while retaining the electronic declaration.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of member states of the Organisation of Eastern Caribbean States do not need to apply for an eTA.

sources.title: Nevis Island Administration: Passport and Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The Nevis Island Administration describes the current online visa channel, the current eTA/ED Form, and passport issuance for citizens.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Travelers who currently require a visa to enter the federation may apply online.

sources.title: Visa (Exemption) Order, statutory schedule
sources.publisher: Law Commission of Saint Christopher and Nevis
sources.officialityEvidence: The official consolidated 2017 statute publishes the Visa (Exemption) Order and its nationality schedule, but it is not treated as a current exhaustive schedule without a current confirmation.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Aliens being citizens of the countries mentioned in the Schedule ... shall be exempt.

policies.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis ordinary passport: citizenship
policies.summary: A Saint Kitts and Nevis citizen is classified as citizenship rather than a foreign visitor-visa relationship.
conditions: Immigration Act section 4 grants a citizen a right to enter at any time. This is not a finding about residence, work, diplomatic, emergency, or special-document processing.

policies.title: OECS Protocol Member ordinary passports: visa-free entry
policies.summary: The five other catalog OECS Protocol Member State citizens have the statutory indefinite-entry permit; the eTA release confirms they need not apply for an eTA.
conditions: Immigration Act section 4(3), subject to statutory prohibited-person procedures, requires an immigration officer to grant an indefinite-entry permit to a Protocol Member State citizen.

The 2025 eTA release says OECS citizens need not apply for eTA, but they must complete the electronic Immigration and Customs declaration. This does not establish ordinary tourist treatment for non-Protocol CARICOM citizens, residents, diplomats, crew, transit, work, or special documents.
